original_ref_supports_true_explanation: Independently re-fetched the PR Newswire release (2022-08-09) and confirmed the researcher's reading: it states the 2 MTPA Palu LNG import terminal 'will supply carbon neutral LNG for the captive 1.2 GW combined cycle powerplant' serving nickel-smelter industries. 'Captive' modifies the powerplant's relationship to the smelter/mining industrial host, not the terminal's own operations -- the release contains no statement that the terminal itself has on-site generation. url_verifier PASS confirms the exact phrase is still on the live page.
refutation_search_summary: Multiple adversarial searches (Bing, DuckDuckGo html/lite) for 'Palu LNG genset', 'Palu LNG pembangkit/PLTGU', and 'Aslan Energy Capital Palu' returned no results describing on-site gas generation at the terminal. Found one newer lead not in the researcher's file: a May 2026 MoU (jawawa.id, PT Bangun Palu Sulawesi Tengah x Aslan Energy Capital) for a $1.75B 'battery gigafactory and LNG hub' at Palu SEZ -- this article gives no technical detail on the LNG terminal or any gas power plant. Aslan's own current projects page (aslanec.com/projects, url_verifier PASS on '400 MW') now describes the 'Palu Green Energy Hub' as 400 MW solar plus a 180 t/day green-ammonia plant, with NO mention of LNG or a gas-fired CCGT at all -- consistent with the original 1.2 GW gas plant design having been dropped/superseded in favor of solar+battery, which if anything strengthens the case against any captive gas generation existing at this site now or as designed. No source anywhere, old or new, describes on-site/onboard gas-fired generation at the Palu LNG terminal itself.
recommendation: uphold overturn -- stage CaptiveGasPower True to False for Palu LNG Terminal; keep the existing PR Newswire ref as the qa/evidentiary basis for the correction (it was misread as terminal captive power when it actually describes the powerplant's captivity to the smelter host -- the direction-test case). No corroborating second source is needed since this is a deletion of an unsupported value, not a new positive claim.
